p: Endries is being pleasing as a rookie who makes plays when he gets the ball.
Taylor praised him alongside Young, but no specific increase in role was promised.
I've been pleased with those two rookies.
Will step into a larger tight end role with All and Hudson hurt.
The rookie tight end is a streaming or deep-league pickup with a clear path to snaps.
I'm not nervous at all about using him. I think he's earned the opportunity.
